The settings digests cover each section's pydantic JSON schema and default values. Docstring edits to a section class appear in its schema description and so move its digest; that is intended, but a reviewer should know it.
The backtest pin fixes code_version to 'f' * 40 because the report prints the git HEAD, which changes with every commit. The unpinned two-run comparison (plan command 4) holds only at a single HEAD.

The plan wording 'risk_json (19 STEP_IDS)' does not match the code: risk_json holds reason, order_hash, capped and caps; the 19 rows exist only on RiskDecision.evaluated and are never persisted. The test pins the real shape and asserts the rows are absent from risk_json. The reviewer should confirm the intent.

The replay hash checks inside test_engine_evaluate.py re-measure through the cli main verb in an empty directory rather than importing tests/replay/pin_support, which is not importable from tests/characterization without a sys.path edit.
